# meraki_appliance_vpn_site_to_site_hub_vrfs (Resource)

This resource can manage the `Appliance VPN Site to Site Hub VRFs` configuration.

~>Warning: This resource or data source depends on an Early Access API endpoint. These API endpoints are subject to breaking changes without prior notice.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "meraki_appliance_vpn_site_to_site_hub_vrfs" "example" {
  network_id     = "L_123456"
  hub_network_id = "L_234567"
  vrfs = [
    {
      id = "12345"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `hub_network_id` (String) Hub network ID
- `network_id` (String) Network ID
- `vrfs` (Attributes List) The list of VRFs for this source and hub mapping. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vrfs))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

<a id="nestedatt--vrfs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vrfs`

Required:

- `id` (String) The VRF ID. Use `0` for the default VRF.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = meraki_appliance_vpn_site_to_site_hub_vrfs.example
  identity = {
    network_id     = "<network_id>"
    hub_network_id = "<hub_network_id>"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `hub_network_id` (String) Hub network ID
- `network_id` (String) Network ID

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = meraki_appliance_vpn_site_to_site_hub_vrfs.example
  id = "<network_id>,<hub_network_id>"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import meraki_appliance_vpn_site_to_site_hub_vrfs.example "<network_id>,<hub_network_id>"
```
